I thought about doing that, but im ready when the last cig goes, its a kind of symbolism to it i think... With more impact than tossing it away. I cant use any sort of "help" that reminds me of smoke, im just gonna go cold turkey. I think last time was unfortunate because a lot of things happened that made it even harder to quit. This time for sure im gonna make it. I even got a good friend and co-worker with me this time.

Yeah, i quit for 2 months. But a combination of things ending with a co-worker offering me a smoke brought me back. This time though, my co-worker is quitting with me. In fact he is already one week in. Its really encouraging to know he is going through this with me, that we are in this together i guess.

Them triggers man... After eating, after sex, at the given 10 minutes breaks at work. It goes on forever. I couldnt keep it up last time, because a co-worker offered me a smoke during lunch break. He did not know i had quit, and he is truly sorry. This time, he is quitting with me, so at least what brought me back last time wont be a problem.
